marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Southbound Capital Inflows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index showed resilience, bolstered by consistent net buying from Southbound Stock Connect capital focusing on major tech leaders like Tencent and Alibaba.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained liquidity support from mainland funds is establishing a valuation floor for major HK internet majors despite cautious global market sentiment.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Federal Reserve rate policy outlook and upcoming Q2 corporate earnings performance.

marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Supply Chain Demand
marketLayer.fact: US semiconductor shares moved higher following reports that major enterprise hyperscalers are maintaining aggressive CapEx plans for next-generation AI hardware and server buildouts.
marketLayer.inference: Strong demand for AI accelerators and high-bandwidth memory continues to benefit top-tier chip manufacturers and equipment suppliers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Regulatory adjustments regarding tech export controls and potential supply chain bottlenecks.

marketLayer.title: HK-Listed EV Manufacturers & Global Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed Chinese EV brands published strong overseas shipment figures, helping offset ongoing domestic price discounting across consumer auto segments.
marketLayer.inference: Market share gains in overseas markets will differentiate resilient EV players from domestic-only automakers operating under tight profit margins.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential foreign tariff implementations and localized policy barriers in key export markets.
